posts.text:
The reason why last night was historic is that an inflection point has now undeniably been reached:

For years, it was clear that supporting AIPAC's positions was bad policy for the US. Yet, it was "good" politics because it kept lawmakers safe in their seats.

No more. The anomaly has been defeated: Bad policy is now also bad politics.

Going forward, more and more lawmakers will internalize that supporting AIPAC and being endorsed by AIPAC is bad for you. It's bad policy and bad politics.
posts.summary: AIPAC positions harm U.S. interests; political leverage shifting away from pro-AIPAC lawmakers
